rationale: Ride-through: The resource remains connected throughout the event. The voltage sag at 0.55 pu lasts 0.5s (from 0.05s to 0.55s), which is within the 0.7s maximum allowed duration for voltages >= 0.5 pu. Reactive current: Voltage drops below 0.9 pu at 0.05s, requiring iq_pu >= 0.2 by 0.15s (0.1s deadline). At 0.12s, iq_pu = 0.25 which meets the requirement, and it remains >= 0.2 through 0.55s while voltage is below 0.9 pu.
